model.name: diagram.discoverAction
model.description: R33.7.2 item-3 INV-DA1/2/3 (design 3ace9bf95): 'Discover relationships' action-bar verb (R33.6.5 class-actions) -> 1-level graph expand from the selected element. discoverRelated reads /api/ior/ior:instance:<uuid> for the selected element's relatesTo[] (out) + relatedFrom[] (in), then addView each immediate neighbor (base class+extends, nav-links+targets, subclasses, implemented interfaces) onto the diagram - buildEdges then wires the relationships. 1 LEVEL ONLY (INV-DA1 bounded, immediate neighbors, not transitive); reuse client-only /api/ior + addView (INV-DA2 no new endpoint); store-only isolation (INV-DA3). Client-only.
